name: Colca Canyon
blurb: Colca Canyon is a deep canyon of the Colca River in southern Peru, located northwest of Arequipa. It is frequently visited for trekking and viewing Andean condors from viewpoints such as Cruz del Condor.

positive: Unforgettable sightings of Andean condors flying overhead
Challenging and rewarding hiking and trekking opportunities
negative: Altitude sickness experienced by some visitors
Only seeing condors from a distance on certain trips

Colca Canyon, Peru is one of the world's deepest, with depths reaching roughly 3,200 to over 4,160 meters (10,000–13,600+ feet), twice as deep as the Grand Canyon

Located near Arequipa, it is a major trekking destination known for Andean condor sightings & Inca terracing

#travel

Colca canyon - Arequipa. Depth 3270 meters or deeper if measured from other villages. Hiking down the valley is challenging and it is worth it. Andean condors can be seen taking off early in the morning. Beautiful sight.
We saw the condors flying in Colca Canyon, Peru. It was an amazing experience despite the altitude sickness I endured to accomplish it. Vale la pena 😵‍💫.
